description_en: Associates host accounts with a host shared key
description_zh: 关联主机账号到主机共享密钥
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-host-accounts-to-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachHostAccountsToHostShareKey

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the bastion host. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机的实例ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the bastion host. For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机的地域ID。Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host shared key.
This parameter is required. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
主机共享密钥的ID。
此参数为必传参数。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of host account IDs.
This parameter is required. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462937.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
主机账号的ID列表。
此参数为必传参数。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462937.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_account_ids

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Code.description_en: The error code. A value of OK indicates that the association was successful. Other error codes indicate that the association failed
Code.description_zh: 错误码。错误码为OK时，表示关联成功；其他错误码表示关联失败

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account

HostShareKeyId.description_en: The ID of the host shared key

Message.example: The host account does not exist
